title: Google’s Gemini 4 Carbon Matches Opus 5.5 in Coding

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Internal researchers at Google are currently validating the benchmarks of an unreleased artificial intelligence model. The system, a Gemini 4 checkpoint codenamed Carbon, matches the coding capabilities of Opus 5.5 and behaves similarly in general use, according to internal documents and screenshots seen by Business Insider.

The trials occur as Google preps for the public release of a different model known as Argon. Carbon serves as the next iteration in the company's AI development sequence and follows the planned deployment of the Argon model.
